title: Attacks on Judge Gonzalo Curiel

speaker: Donald Trump
claim: Trump asserted Curiel was biased against him because of his heritage and Trump's immigration position.
context: Curiel was born in Indiana. Contemporary reporting and later compilations document repeated Trump criticism of Curiel.
status: Public criticism of presiding federal judge; recusal sought/advocated
notes: Date represents the late-May 2016 public attack period; source compilation includes multiple statements.

title: Posthumous criticism of John McCain and funeral
summary: Nearly seven months after Sen. John McCain's death, Trump criticized McCain during remarks in Ohio, complained that he had not been thanked for funeral-related assistance, and said he was not a fan of McCain.
quote: I gave him the kind of funeral that he wanted ... I didn't get 'thank you.' That's OK. We sent him on the way.
speaker: Donald Trump
claim: Trump criticized McCain's record and said he had not been thanked for funeral-related assistance.
context: AP reported that Trump authorized military transport but did not give or arrange McCain's funeral; McCain's family spokesman had publicly thanked the Trump administration and federal agencies for logistical support.
status: Posthumous public criticism of deceased political figure
notes: McCain died Aug. 25, 2018. Trump's better-known 'not a war hero' comments occurred while McCain was alive.
